Every move feels fast, confident, and calculated when you step into the UA Fox 3—De’Aaron Fox’s new signature shoe was built for explosive speed and dead-stop control. Every move feels fast, confident, and calculated when you step into the UA Fox 3—De’Aaron Fox’s new signature shoe was built for explosive speed and dead-stop control. *   Lightweight, breathable second-skin upper for secure lateral moves & explosive speed on the court *   External heel counter provides lightweight support & stability during quick cuts *   TPE-blend sockliner with low compression set delivers energy return & long-lasting comfort *   Energy-returning Charged Cushioning® acts as the engine for a spring-loaded vertical leap *   Decoupled UA Flow outsole for more flexibility for quick sprints & absolute grip for a dead stop Every move feels fast, confident, and calculated when you step into the UA Fox 3—De’Aaron Fox’s new signature shoe was built for explosive speed and dead-stop control. An added internal plate gives stability when you plant and acts as the engine for a spring-loaded vertical leap. We decoupled our UA Flow outsole, so there’s more flexibility for quick sprints and absolute grip for a dead stop. We removed the strap to make the shoe lighter, while still feeling locked in with a second-skin upper for secure lateral moves. This item will be available to purchase soon. Join the waitlist so you’ll be the first to know when it drops. That measurement (in centimeters) is then translated into our standard sizes. To find your foot measurement closely trace your entire foot onto a piece of paper and measure from heel to toe. If your measurement is between chart numbers, we recommend sizing up. Be sure you’re putting your full weight on your foot while tracing. Please note: for the best results, measuring later in the day is recommended. We created this easy-to-use sizing chart so that finding the right size shoes for your kids won’t be a workout in itself. *Due to the metric/imperial conversions, there will be some instances where two US sizes will equal one UK size or one CM size.
